'''Admiral_Sjet Dark Side LSC''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Admiral_Sjet]]
* '''Published:''' 3 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 FirstMove Admiral_Sjet DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

Trying to make a Dark Side LSC with limited cards.

== Strategy ==

Strategy I: Force Draining

--------------------------

Drain at the locations and hope they dont drop some jedi. If they do, battle regularly to eliminate Jedi. Deploy Spies to places to block drains.

Revised: Dark Jedi Cant battle, so use the droids and aliens for attirtion against opponent.

Strategy II: Battle

-------------------

Take your droid and alien task forces and go stomp some rebels or republicans.

Revised: This is probably where id like some commenatry.....i dont activate too much on my own....only two locations.....but i can deploy a character based on my force once per turn. Hopefully i get some extra through the presence of the force as well as through their locations.

Observations

------------

I dont have any UR Palpatines, due to bad drawing power. Secondly, First Strike is in becuase interrupt play is hot in my area, and they either choose to deploy one more character or use the three interrupts they have. Lasty, i dont have Blaster Rack in becuase theres only three weapon cards in my deck so i think it would be real waste.
